# Flame v2.7.4

- Configure multiple custom HTTP headers for quote API endpoints, including API keys, Authorization and tenant headers.
- Preserve existing Bearer and query-string authentication and allow additional headers alongside them.
- Store header values privately in SQLite; return only names to authenticated settings clients and allow retaining, updating and removing individual values.
- Validate names, values, duplicates and reserved transport headers. Apply the same request configuration to previews and homepage quotes.
- Add an optional minimum refresh interval (None, 1 minute to 24 hours), shared server-side caching and request deduplication; retain the last successful quote on errors.
- Keep endpoint previews uncached and add unit, HTTP and Chromium regression tests. Update quote API documentation.

Docker images are published for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
